about.text: Lancashire is an English cow cheese from the county of Lancashire, traditionally made by mixing curds of two or three days.

facts.v: Creamy and tasty standardised in the 1890s by Joseph Gornall; crumbly created in the 1950s for mass production
Creamy (4–12 weeks), Tasty (12 weeks to 24 months), Crumbly (6–8 weeks, made from one day's milk)
Creamy is traditionally eaten with Eccles or Chorley cakes
